detail: Spread in price units, commission fractional, friction=2.296 bps, hurdle=3.296 bps.
Labeling sets classification threshold; evaluator computes PnL with ask/bid fills. Zero double-counting.
Weekend closures (>300s) use intra-bar return and group-isolated multi-bar shifts. Zero weekend jump leakage.
Missing bars (>300s) reset multi-bar shifts and use intra-bar return without interpolation. Functionally sound, but does not distinguish weekend closure from intraday gap.
0.0 fills represent zero price change during session initialization, avoiding NaN propagation.
Modifying bars at t >= 30 produces 0.00e+00 difference in all 12 features for t < 30.
Prediction at bar t close executes at bar t+1 open; exit is at bar t+1+h open. Validated against hand calculation.
All bars with incomplete forward horizons strictly return NaN. Zero synthetic label fabrication.
Momentum baseline evaluates explicit fold indices without trailing-segment assumptions.
FX-FEAT-v1.0.0 enforced. Datasets with mismatched schema versions are strictly rejected with ValueError.
